s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive neurological decline with motor and speech impairment
salient_findings: Episodes of spasms and tremors in the right hand and forearm
key_facts: Woman in her mid-60s
Initial carpal tunnel release surgery
Recurring tremors
Referred to a neurologist 7 months later
Developed progressive right-sided weakness over 3 months
Brain MRI showed hyperintensities in bilateral cerebral hemispheric white matter and other areas
No contrast enhancement on T1-weighted MRI
Brain biopsy showed CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+ cells
Cerebrospinal fluid contained lymphoma cells
Bone marrow was negative for lymphoma cells

rule_out.why: it typically presents with progressive hemiparesis or monoparesis without prominent spasms and tremors

trace.fact: Progressive right-sided weakness

rule_out.why: it typically presents with bilateral and asymmetric symptoms

trace.fact: Dysarthria and slurred speech

rule_in.why: it often presents with dysarthria

rule_out.why: it is compatible with all candidates

trace.fact: Gait instability

rule_in.why: it is commonly associated with gait instability

rule_out.why: it is compatible with all candidates

trace.fact: Woman in her mid-60s

rule_in.why: age is not discriminative

rule_out.why: age is compatible with all candidates

trace.fact: Initial carpal tunnel release surgery

rule_in.why: it does not discriminate between the candidates

rule_out.why: it does not discriminate between the candidates

trace.fact: Recurring tremors

rule_in.why: it is most closely associated with tremors

rule_out.why: tremors are compatible with multiple conditions

trace.fact: Referred to a neurologist 7 months later

rule_in.why: referral timing is non-specific

rule_out.why: delayed referral does not discriminate

trace.fact: Developed progressive right-sided weakness over 3 months

rule_in.why: it often presents with progressive unilateral weakness

rule_out.why: progressive symptoms over months is unusual for this condition

trace.fact: Brain MRI showed hyperintensities in bilateral cerebral hemispheric white matter and other areas

rule_in.why: it typically presents with white matter hyperintensities on MRI

rule_out.why: it typically presents with asymmetric cortical atrophy

trace.fact: No contrast enhancement on T1-weighted MRI

rule_in.why: it typically shows contrast enhancement on T1-weighted MRI, but the absence is more unusual in other conditions

rule_out.why: it typically shows contrast enhancement on T1-weighted MRI

trace.fact: Brain biopsy showed CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+ cells

rule_in.why: immunophenotype consistent with lymphoma

rule_out.why: immunophenotype is not typical of corticobasal degeneration

trace.fact: Cerebrospinal fluid contained lymphoma cells

rule_in.why: lymphoma cells in cerebrospinal fluid

rule_out.why: lymphoma cells are present in some candidates

trace.fact: Bone marrow was negative for lymphoma cells

rule_in.why: it is more consistent with a localized lymphoma

rule_out.why: negative bone marrow for lymphoma cells
